title: More Is Never Less: Affordable Robustness to Additive Attacks via Monotone Multiple-Instance Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.28825v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Static malware detectors that represent each sample as a bag of extracted features, such as permissions, API calls, or imported functions, are cheap to deploy and remain state-of-the-art under temporal drift and in selective classification. Yet, attackers can evade them by adding benign-looking content that outweighs malicious evidence. Canonically, detectors encode the presence of a few thousand features, selected during training, as sparse multi-hot vectors over a fixed vocabulary. Features that emerge after training remain invisible. We show that linear models and multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) over this input are sum-pooled set models in disguise. Sum-pooling lets added benign features cancel malicious evidence. Instead, we cast malware detection with set-shaped static features as a multiple-instance learning (MIL) problem. translated_title: 多者永不为少：通过单调多示例学习实现对加性攻击的低成本鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 将每个样本表示为提取特征包（如权限、API调用或导入函数）的静态恶意软件检测器部署成本低，并且在时间漂移和选择性分类场景下仍保持最先进水平。然而，攻击者可以通过添加看似良性的内容来抵消恶意证据，从而逃避这些检测器的检测。传统上，检测器将训练期间选择的数千个特征的存在编码为固定词表上的稀疏多热向量，而训练后出现的新特征则保持不可见。我们证明，基于这种输入的线性模型和多层感知机（MLP）实际上是伪装的和池化集合模型。和池化使得攻击者添加的良性特征能够抵消恶意证据。与此相反，我们将具有集合形状静态特征的恶意软件检测视为多示例学习（MIL）问题。为此，我们提出了MalSets，它使用带有单调头部的最大池化Deep Sets模型来确保……
tldr: 本文揭示传统静态恶意软件检测器中的线性模型和MLP本质上是和池化集合模型，易被攻击者通过添加良性特征抵消恶意证据，并提出MalSets——将恶意软件检测建模为采用带单调头部的最大池化Deep Sets的多示例学习问题，以低成本实现对加性攻击的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that linear models and MLPs in static malware detection are disguised sum-pooled set models vulnerable to additive attacks, and proposes MalSets, which casts malware detection as multiple-instance learning using max-pooled Deep Sets with a monotone head to achieve affordable robustness against such attacks.
